turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Reddy from Nagpur?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Reddy. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: My name is Ananya from the bank fraud prevention team. We have noticed a suspicious attempt for fifty thousand rupees on your account.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What? Fifty thousand? I have not done any such transaction!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I understand, sir. Was this payment made by you or anyone in your family?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: No, no, not at all. Please tell me what is happening.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not worry, sir. I am blocking your card right now to prevent any money from leaving your account.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, please block it quickly. Do you need my account number for this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, I have your details on my screen. I just need you to confirm if you have your physical card with you?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, it is right here in my wallet.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Perfect. The card is now blocked. Please remember that the bank will never ask you for your OTP, PIN, or CVV over the phone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank you, beta. I was very scared for a moment.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You are welcome, Mr. Reddy. Please visit your home branch tomorrow to apply for a replacement card.
